note: End-of-day official series from the issuing institutions. Not a real-time quote feed.

series.label: EUR/USD
series.note: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rate, published each business day at 16:00 CET.

series.label: USD/CAD
series.note: Daily average exchange rate: daily value of the US dollar expressed in Canadian dollars, for 1 unit of US dollar

series.label: Canada 10-year bond yield
series.note: The yield on the Government of Canada 10-year benchmark bond. This series represents the prevailing market interest rate for the 10-year Government of Canada bond and is used as a reference for financial market analysis

series.label: Canada 2-year bond yield
series.note: The yield on the Government of Canada 2-year benchmark bond. This series reflects the prevailing interest rate for the 2-year term and is used to monitor short-term government borrowing costs.

series.label: Bank of Canada target rate
series.note: Also called the policy interest rate, the average rate that the Bank of Canada wants to see in the market for overnight money market financing. (V39079)

series.label: US Treasury 1m
series.note: Daily par yield curve rate published by the US Treasury.

series.label: US Treasury 3m
series.note: Daily par yield curve rate published by the US Treasury.

series.label: US Treasury 6m
series.note: Daily par yield curve rate published by the US Treasury.

series.label: US Treasury 1y
series.note: Daily par yield curve rate published by the US Treasury.

series.label: US Treasury 2y
series.note: Daily par yield curve rate published by the US Treasury.

series.label: US Treasury 3y
series.note: Daily par yield curve rate published by the US Treasury.

series.label: US Treasury 5y
series.note: Daily par yield curve rate published by the US Treasury.

series.label: US Treasury 7y
series.note: Daily par yield curve rate published by the US Treasury.

series.label: US Treasury 10y
series.note: Daily par yield curve rate published by the US Treasury.

series.label: US Treasury 20y
series.note: Daily par yield curve rate published by the US Treasury.

series.label: US Treasury 30y
series.note: Daily par yield curve rate published by the US Treasury.

series.label: Yield curve (10y − 2y)
series.note: Computed from the Treasury par curve. Negative values are an inversion.

series.label: Average rate on federal debt
series.note: The weighted average coupon the US government actually pays. Adjusts slowly, as old bonds mature.

series.label: S&P 500
series.note: Large-cap US equities, now heavily weighted toward a handful of technology franchises.

series.label: Nasdaq Composite
series.note: Long-duration growth equity — the most sensitive major index to real rates.

series.label: Dow Jones Industrial Average
series.note: Price-weighted and only thirty names, which makes it a poor index and a famous one.

series.label: VIX
series.note: The price of insurance against equity moves. Rises with uncertainty and with leverage unwinds.

series.label: High-yield credit spread
series.note: Option-adjusted spread over Treasuries. The cleanest continuously-priced read on perceived corporate risk.

series.label: Investment-grade credit spread
series.note: The same measure for the investment-grade universe, where the marginal borrower is far larger.

series.label: Crude oil (WTI)
series.note: The single most macro-consequential price: an input to nearly everything, and a transfer between producers and consumers.

series.label: Natural gas (Henry Hub)
series.note: Regional rather than global — pipelines and LNG terminals set the price.

series.label: Copper
series.note: The metal of electrification. Monthly, because the IMF publishes it monthly.

series.label: European natural gas
series.note: Europe's marginal energy cost, and the reason its terms of trade moved so violently after 2022.

series.label: 10-year real yield (TIPS)
series.note: The number that actually governs investment decisions, and the discount rate for every long-duration asset.

series.label: 10-year breakeven inflation
series.note: What the bond market prices for average inflation over a decade — contaminated by liquidity and risk premia.

series.label: 5-year breakeven inflation
series.note: The nearer-term half of the same measure.

series.label: 30-year mortgage rate
series.note: Priced off the 10-year plus a spread that widens when mortgage-backed securities are hard to hedge.

series.label: Trade-weighted dollar
series.note: A global financial condition rather than a price — dollar strength tightens conditions for every dollar borrower.

series.label: Financial conditions index
series.note: Positive is tighter than average, negative looser. Aggregates rates, spreads, equity and leverage.
